notes: Sun Joe SPX3000 electric pressure washer (2030 PSI, 14.5 A) as described in manual forms MR2 and MR14. The SPX3000-XT1 is a different model (13 A, 2200 PSI) and is not covered.

gaps: Weight conflict: 31 lb (14 kg) on form MR2 and 27.6 lb (12.5 kg) on MR14. No weight is claimed.
MR2 gives the motor as 14.5 amp (1800 W); MR14 gives 14.5 amp with no wattage. The motor figures follow MR2.
Pressure wording differs: MR2 lists rated 1450 PSI, max 2030 PSI and max rated flow 1.76 GPM; the pump claim follows MR2.

MR14 calls 2030 PSI the maximum at initial discharge and 1450 PSI the rated pressure under typical load, gives 1.76 GPM as max flow with the nozzle open, and adds 1.24 GPM rated flow under typical load.
The figures in the pump claim are the washer's technical data; the manual does not break them down for the pump.
Motor type (universal or induction) is not stated in the MR2 text.
Pump make and type are not stated.
The manual does not say where the unloader valve, thermal sensor or flow micro-switch sit, so no locations are given.
No frame material or tube frame is described, so no tube frame is claimed.
No part numbers appear in the manuals; no parts list or exploded diagram was found.
method: Sun Joe SPX3000 operator's manual, form SJ-SPX3000-880E-MR2 (Snow Joe, 2014), Home Depot document server copy: component list and technical data page 5, carton list page 6, safety devices page 2, Total Stop System page 9.

Snow Joe SPX3000 operator's manual, form SJ-SPX3000-880E-MR14 (files.snowjoe.com, the maker's own site): cross-check of ratings, weight, component list and safety devices. The RONA copy of MR14 had the same text.
Snow Joe SPX3000-XT1 operator's manual, form MR1 (files.snowjoe.com): read only to tell the variants apart (13 A, 2200 PSI); no part claim is taken from it.
No snowjoe.com copy of form MR2 was found.

comps.spec: Electric motor, listed in the technical data as 14.5 amp (1800 W); the unit is rated 120 V 60 Hz
Pump of the washer; the technical data lists the unit at 2030 PSI maximum pressure, 1450 PSI rated pressure and 1.76 GPM maximum rated flow
Micro-switch sensitive to water flow (the manual's Total Stop System): when the trigger is released and water stops flowing through the pump, it turns the motor off
Thermal sensor that protects the motor against overloading; the machine restarts after a few minutes once the sensor has cooled
Unloader valve, which the manual says can reduce pressure if it exceeds preset values
Trigger gun (component list no. 5) with trigger (no. 2) and safety lock (no. 1), and the spray wand that fits into it (no. 6)
High-pressure hose, 20 ft (6 m), with a garden hose adaptor (female coupler) for the water inlet
Five quick-connect nozzles: 0, 15, 25 and 40 degrees, and a black soap nozzle, with onboard storage for them
Two removable detergent tanks, stored on the unit (carton list)
Power cord with GFCI, 35 ft (10.7 m)
